name: Residual Energy doubles the duration of Shadow of the Void (#653)
contract: Residual Energy 681389 reads 'Doubles the duration of Shadow of the Void.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 31, effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 7999 / DieSides 1 = +8000 ms, class mask dword 0 = 256 = bit 8. Shadow of the Void 300277 (family 31) carries SpellFamilyFlags[0] 256 (bit 8) -- exact match -- and DurationIndex 31, whose SpellDuration.dbc row is Duration 8000 ms (verified directly). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10323) computes SPELLMOD_DURATION as (base+totalflat)*totalmul (line 10323); with only the flat +8000 mod, 8000 -> (8000+8000)*1 = 16000, exactly double. Grasp of Zek'voz 573028 (family 31, SpellFamilyFlags[0]=2) does not carry bit 8 and is the control.

steps.label: SETUP: Shadow of the Void's real 8000 ms duration is unmodified
Shadow of the Void's duration is now 16000 ms (doubled)
Grasp of Zek'voz is outside the mask
Shadow of the Void returns to 8000 ms
